What makes a puja “traditional”?

  • Ekchala pratima — Durga and her children under a single arched frame, the classic Bengali form.
  • Daaker saaj — white shola-pith ornaments, once shipped “by post” (daak) from Kolkata.
  • Chalchitra — the painted arch behind the idol showing scenes from the Puranas.
  • Dhak and kansor at aarti, with dhunuchi dance in the evenings.

Frequently asked questions

Where can I see a traditional ekchala Durga idol in Siliguri?

Traditional pujas such as those in Hakimpara and the central paras keep the ekchala form. The list on this page shows the top-rated traditional and heritage pujas on the 2026 map.

What is daaker saaj?

Daaker saaj is the classic white shola-pith ornamentation of the Durga idol. The name comes from “daak” (post), as the ornaments were once sent by post from Kolkata.

When is Sandhi Puja in 2026?

Sandhi Puja falls at the juncture of Ashtami and Navami (19–20 October 2026). Check the Puja schedule page for the exact timing.

Are traditional pujas less crowded than theme pandals?

Usually yes, except during anjali and Sandhi Puja, when local residents gather.
